title: First H-bomb and the 1952 DC wave
summary: Jesse Michels tells of First H-bomb and the 1952 DC wave, about 1952 at Washington, D.C., and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: What happened in 1952? The DC UFO sightings in in July.

plain: Jesse Michels links the wave of UFO sightings over Washington, D.C. in July 1952 to the American work that year on the first hydrogen bomb, a far more powerful nuclear weapon, tested in the Pacific. He raises it himself as a question, "What happened in 1952?", and answers with the Washington sightings, without naming a source. The idea is that the sightings may have been a response to a leap in nuclear power.
